content:
According to a new report from Bloomberg, Apple is laying off employees across multiple teams. Overall, the company has cut more than 200 positions across its Vision Pro, Siri, and software engineering teams.

An Apple spokesperson said in a statement that the adjustments are meant to "advance the business and deliver the best experience for users."

The report says around 100 of the eliminated positions came from the Vision Pro team. Among them, Apple is "significantly dissolving a Vision Pro team focused on gaming." The team responsible for producing immersive videos for Vision Pro will also be reduced in size.

Looking ahead, Apple still plans to "produce a smaller number of videos in-house," while encouraging third parties to create immersive content.

The report continues:

At the same time, Apple has also cut around 100 positions from its Siri and software teams.

The report says the Siri restructuring is related to the rollout of Siri AI. Apple's brand-new Siri AI platform is built on a revamped technical architecture, changing the "expertise" required by the Siri team. As a result, Apple has decided to "delete a small number of existing roles, reallocate resources, and create new positions to support the new version of Siri."

Apple's "Intelligent Systems Experience team" has also been affected by this round of layoffs.

Bloomberg's report today builds on earlier reporting, which said Apple had laid off around 60 employees from its Vision Pro team.
